glossary.SaaS: Software as a Service, subscription-delivered cloud business software.
glossary.Agent: An autonomous entity that perceives its environment and takes multi-step actions using tools to achieve goals.
glossary.MCP: Model Context Protocol, an open standard by Anthropic connecting AI assistants to data sources and tool servers.
glossary.Tool Calling: LLM selecting and invoking external functions/APIs based on structured JSON schema.
glossary.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, fetching relevant domain context before LLM answer generation.
glossary.SSE: Server-Sent Events, real-time unidirection streaming protocol from backend server to browser.
